description: An application that scans NASA satellite pixels and scientific arrays in real time to turn Earth observation visuals into synchronized music and audio waveforms.
summary:
Earthify is an interactive Earth Jukebox. It is a system which analyses the NASA Earth Information Centre (EIC). We want to make scientific information easier to understand and have created a system which will take the visuals from NASA and translate them into music.We have sonified the data and created a way to use music to understand the environmental information. Each instrument represents a different element of the environment. For example temperature, wind speed, humidity, and rainfall. As the environmental factors change, the music will change to match. This makes it easier to understand scientific information. 
Making the information easily accessible to all is a key part of this project. Scientific information is often difficult to understand when viewed in graphs, charts, and statistics. This can be confusing for children, people with no scientific background, and people who are visually impaired. By combining earth science factors with music and technology, we make complex environmental information more interactive, intuitive and enjoyable. We believe that knowledge about our planet should not be limited to people who can see, so we have created a way to hear instead of read. This will make earth science accessible to many.
The earth is always changing, so it is important we understand the changes. Our aim is to inspire curiosity and to simply give everybody the chance to experience the ever changing environment of our planet using music in a more intuitive way.
details:
• interactive platform transforming NASA earth observation data into music, 4 environmental variables: temperature, wind speed, humidity, and rainfall
  • environmental data translated into musical characteristic
  • It makes complex scientific data easier to understand and experience, and creates an alternative to traditional graphs and statistics. It provides an auditory alternative to graphs, charts, and statistics, and helps people with visual impairments explore environmental information through sound. supports different learning styles 
  • It helps in making earth observation data more approachable for blind and visually impaired people. Also, helping the children, non experts and people who struggle with interpreting statistics, and supporting a deeper understanding of environmental change.
  • Tech Stack used: React, JavaScript, Vite, CSS, WebGL, Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, NASA POWER and NASA imagery, OpenStreetMap Nominatim, HTTPX, NumPy, SciPy, SoundFile, Pillow, OpenCV, and Pytest.
  • Creative: Earthify is a combination of earth science, music, and technology
  • environmental variables represented through sounds. Provides an interactive exploration connecting geographical information and musical experience, combining artistic expression to make science more inclusive.
    Factors considered: 
  • scientific accuracy and representation of NASA data 
  • accessibility for visually impaired users and people with limited understanding 
  • user interaction and understandable presentation of information 
  • different ages, learning abilities and educational backgrounds 
  • balancing artistic creativity with scientific interpretation
